title: Mode-Dependent Rectification for Stable PPO Training
abstract: arXiv:2602.05619v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mode-dependent architectural components (layers that behave differently during training and evaluation, such as Batch Normalization or dropout) are commonly used in visual reinforcement learning but can destabilize on-policy optimization. We show that in Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), discrepancies between training and evaluation behavior induced by Batch Normalization lead to policy mismatch, distributional drift, and reward collapse. We propose Mode-Dependent Rectification (MDR), a lightweight dual-phase training procedure that stabilizes PPO under mode-dependent layers without architectural changes. Experiments across procedurally generated games and real-world patch-localization tasks demonstrate that MDR consistently improves stability and performance, and extends naturally to other mode-dependent layers.

translated_title: 模式依赖校正用于稳定PPO训练
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2602.05619v2 公告类型：跨库替换  摘要：模式依赖的架构组件（在训练和评估期间行为不同的层，如批归一化或丢弃法）常用于视觉强化学习，但可能破坏在线策略优化。我们证明，在近端策略优化（PPO）中，由批归一化引起的训练与评估行为差异导致策略不匹配、分布漂移和奖励崩溃。我们提出模式依赖校正（MDR），一种轻量级双阶段训练程序，在不改变架构的情况下稳定模式依赖层下的PPO。在程序生成游戏和真实世界补丁定位任务上的实验表明，MDR持续提高稳定性和性能，并自然扩展到其他模式依赖层。
tldr: 提出了一种轻量级双阶段训练程序（MDR），在不改变架构的情况下，通过校正模式依赖层（如批归一化）引起的训练与评估行为差异，稳定PPO训练并防止策略不匹配和奖励崩溃。
en_tdlr: Proposes a lightweight dual-phase training procedure (MDR) that stabilizes PPO training without architectural changes by rectifying discrepancies between training and evaluation behavior in mode-dependent layers like Batch Normalization, preventing policy mismatch and reward collapse.
